comment: Standards-based APIs are required, but the core attributes mention only creation, query, cross-referencing, and subscription. Merge, unlink, history, provenance, assurance, and relationship operations are also important.

public.text: Standards-based APIs are required, but the core attributes mention only creation, query, cross-referencing, and subscription. Merge, unlink, history, provenance, assurance, and relationship operations are also important.
public.suggestedRevision: Define the full service catalogue and actor roles in a versioned national implementation guide, including security, consent or legal-basis enforcement, error responses, and audit.
